# Sankofa Impact

> > Sankofa Impact is a Seattle-based organization offering place-based civil rights education through Project Pilgrimage, bringing communities to historic sites across the American South to learn from movement veterans and foster collective liberation.

Founded on principles of truth-telling and racial reconciliation, Sankofa Impact partners with institutions like the University of Washington to create transformative learning experiences in cities like Montgomery, Selma, and Memphis. The organization honors civil rights activists, organizers, and allies while building bridges between historical struggle and contemporary social justice movements.

## Key Topics

- Project Pilgrimage
- Place-based learning
- Civil rights movement
- Montgomery Bus Boycott
- SNCC (Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee)
- Collective liberation

- Racial reconciliation

## Civil Rights Leaders & Organizers

- [Ella Baker](https://sankofaimpact.org/ella-baker): Profile of Ella Baker, civil rights organizer & SNCC founder
- [Ida B. Wells-Barnett](https://sankofaimpact.org/ida-b-wells-barnett): Biography of Ida B. Wells-Barnett, anti-lynching journalist & activist
- [Grace Lee Boggs](https://sankofaimpact.org/grace-lee-boggs): Biography of Grace Lee Boggs, activist & grassroots organizer in Detroit
- [Robert Graetz, Minister and courageous friend of the Pilgrimage, dies at 92](https://sankofaimpact.org/robert-graetz-minister-and-courageous-friend-of-the-pilgrimage-dies-at-92): Obituary honoring Robert Graetz, Montgomery bus boycott ally & friend
- [Gladys Bentley](https://sankofaimpact.org/gladys-bentley): Profile of Gladys Bentley, Harlem Renaissance blues performer & LGBTQ icon

## Historical Sites & Movement History

- [Black History Month 2023: Montgomery, AL](https://sankofaimpact.org/black-history-month-2023-montgomery-al): Montgomery's slavery history & Commerce Street's role in slave trade
- [A History of Violence and Activism](https://sankofaimpact.org/a-history-of-violence-and-activism): Dr. Bernard Lafayette & Charlottesville protest in civil rights context
- [AAPI History Month: Building the Railroad](https://sankofaimpact.org/aapi-history-month-building-the-railroad): Chinese railroad workers' history & transcontinental railroad memorial
- [Return to Center](https://sankofaimpact.org/return-to-center): Reflection on ancestral return journey to Ghana & diaspora healing

## Contemporary Activism & Social Justice

- [Athletes and activism](https://sankofaimpact.org/athletes-and-activism): Michael Bennett & history of athlete activism for racial justice
- [Jackie Robinson Day](https://sankofaimpact.org/jackie-robinson-day): Jackie Robinson Day tribute honoring baseball integration & civil rights
- [Black History of the Oscars](https://sankofaimpact.org/black-history-of-the-oscars): Academy Awards history examining Black representation & #OscarsSoWhite
- [Ta-Nehisi Coates](https://sankofaimpact.org/ta-nehisi-coates): Ta-Nehisi Coates profile & Seattle Arts Lectures speaking event

## Community & Programs
